title: Synchronize Diagram Pan And Zoom
summary: Phase 2 of the Next.js + PostgreSQL server migration. Created auth API route for developer/key management. Fixed pg-boss v10 work handler signatures. Installed npm dependencies and verified Next.js build (all 12 API routes + landing page). Created Docker Compose setup (postgres, web, worker, caddy reverse proxy), Caddyfile, .env.example. Refactored Go CLI with server client module (getServerAddr, serverRequest, syncTicketToServer, serverWhoami), updated SaveTicket to sync to server, added auth command (whoami + status), and updated Emit endpoint from /events to /api/v1/events. All builds pass (Next.js build, Go CLI compile, Go shared lib compile). CLI tests pass.
